ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 25% of the visible surface area, primarily at distal tips and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central zone; distinct high-intensity white pixel blobs at the outer distal tips of both lobes; white mottling and streaking localized along the trailing edges and extending into the dark field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels creating a jagged topographic profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve; trailing edges demonstrate a complex concave sweep from the notch transitioning to convexity at the lobe centers.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, brownish-grey pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating a textured, high-contrast surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as thin streaks against the dark ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at distal lobe tips; multiple white linear rake marks on the right lobe ventral surface; irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge suggesting minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray pixels at the base of the fluke partially obscure the junction between the lobes and the peduncle.
